First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.
I always thank my God concerning you, for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus;
We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,
remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ…
But when Timothy came just now to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good…
For what thanksgiving can we render again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before…
But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and…
It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my…
I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,
Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.
They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.
But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”
Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear…
This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,
Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and…
But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one…
for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound…
Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection…
Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral…
But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

translations.web: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,
translations.bsb: We are obligated to thank God for you all the time, brothers, as is fitting, because your faith is growing more and more, and your love for one another is increasing.
translations.kjv: We are bound to thank God always for you, brethren, as it is meet, because that your faith groweth exceedingly, and the charity of every one of you all toward each other aboundeth;
translations.asv: We are bound to give thanks to God always to you, brethren, even as it is meet, for that your faith growth exceedingly, and the love of each one of you all toward one another aboundeth;
